author: Chatrchyan, S. and others
title: Measurement of the $B_s^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ Branching Fraction and Search for $B^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ with the CMS Experiment
abstract: We present results from a search for the rare leptonic decays $B_s^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ and $B^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ in pp collisions at $\\sqrt{s} = 7$ and 8 TeV, with data samples of 5 and 20 fb$^{-1}$, respectively, collected by the CMS experiment at the LHC. With an unbinned maximum-likelihood fit to the dimuon invariant mass distributions we determine a branching fraction $\\mathcal{B}(B_s^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-) = (3.0^{+1.0}_{-0.9}) \\times 10^{-9}$, where the uncertainty includes the dominant statistical and small systematic contributions. For the decay $B^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ an upper limit of $\\mathcal{B}(B^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-) < 1.1 \\times 10^{-9}$ at the 95% confidence level is determined. An excess of $B_s^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ events with respect to background is observed with a significance of 4.3 standard deviations.
